reason: Alpha.6 PR2' (Lane 2) ships the review router and its non-authorizing assignment fact family, DORMANT — no durable writer, no importer, nothing wired to allow. Five lane modules: types.ts (the eight laws A-1..A-8 in the module doc, the three fact-type literals named exactly as PR #319 section 6 specified them, the 18 refusal codes and 11 router reason codes, ReviewAssignment/ReviewAssignmentState/ReviewHandoffPlan; the eligible-lifecycle list is IMPORTED from contracts' MEMBER_LIFECYCLE_STATES rather than retyped, because the first draft gated on a state called 'active' which exists nowhere in the frozen five and would have kept passing by refusing everything — the same dead-vocabulary defect PR3' caught in its own lane); facts.ts (the single encoder/decoder/fold for the durable row: ten flat scalar fields, a closed-field check that runs AFTER an authority-marker check so an attempt to grant authority is reported as AUTHORITY_FIELD_PRESENT and not as an unknown field, epoch = previousEpoch + 1 enforced on both the write and read sides, foldReviewAssignmentRows which ignores other families silently and reports this family's failures as permanent diagnostics plus an unreconciled flag, maySubmitFor which demands both halves of the Leader identity — the host's isLeaderInstance fact AND the frozen LEADER_INSTANCE_ID — because a boolean a caller could copy is not an identity, and checkAssignmentMutation as the writer's pre-flight); router.ts (routeReviewCase: structural refusal, then leaveWithLeader for a leg-less row, a stale leg, an absent or unbranded plan, a plan of another epoch, an absent/revoked/non-covering mandate, an officer missing from the host snapshot or in a lifecycle it cannot be routed in, and self-interest as requester/beneficiary/subject; it calls PR0's evaluateReviewAdmission over the mandate's own decision values, so the router is never wider than the admission gate; and it does NOT re-rank a case the Leader took over by handoff, because a wake is not a new argument); handoff.ts (planHandoff/planRetirement, whose ReviewHandoffPlan carries controlServiceEffects typed readonly [] and rungChanged typed false — A-6, handoff is not escalateApprovalLeg, expressed as a compile error rather than a sentence); index.ts (barrel plus the dormancy declaration). Two specs, 81 legs measured by vitest on this tree: a6-pr2-assignment-kernel (64 legs across the eight laws: encode/decode round trip over the closed field set, 17 authority-bearing key shapes all refused with the authority code and none with the unknown-field code, every missing field refused, the MIRROR PIN that walks projection-source.ts from the fact literal to the mirrored constant to its FACT_TYPE_CATEGORY entry and requires 'team' — an unmapped factType does not fail a build, it breaks team.getProjection forever, which is why control-request-abandoned and artifact-read-granted are both in that file's history; CAS legs for already-active/epoch-conflict/target-unchanged/out-of-order/cross-team/other-case rows plus the interleaved-other-family-rows-are-silence leg that makes 'no second index' a fact; a pre-flight-versus-fold agreement leg that walks seven state shapes in both directions so the writer and the fold can never disagree about the same row; stale-target legs including after retirement and on an unreconciled fold; the router matrix including determinism with a reversed candidate list, the seven mutations of the mandate law answering three distinct codes, self-interest three ways, four malformed snapshots refused loudly, and the never-wider-than-admission loop that drives nine adversarial inputs through PR0 and this router together with a positive control so it cannot pass by refusing everything; handoff legs including the pinned empty plan shape and the fact that no lane file names escalateApprovalLeg in call position; and the closed-vocabulary leg that requires every refusal code to be producible and every produced code to be declared, in both directions), a6-pr2-lane-hygiene (17 legs: exact module set, the closed export list of facts.ts and handoff.ts so no second encoder can appear, zero production consumers with seven positive controls and a negative control and the per-package non-empty floor PR3' round-5 review had to add, no reverse import of the ARC-A protected centre AND no import of review-wake so no merge order between the two PRs can be smuggled in through an import edge, both tsconfigs naming the lane, tsconfig.build.json still plain-JSON parseable, the eight frozen ledger categories still eight with the lane adding no ninth, the pure-lane import allow-list and lexical clock/IO floor, and the vanished-scratch walk leg).
